title: Encounter beats two and three: Rotor on the wall beside the mouth, take-control shot into the optic, cannon fodder held at the gate
context: Owner direction: sentries build on high ground by default, the first Rotor on the wall just outside the gate one cell to the side; a short cinematic turning around the sentry and settling behind it as the player takes control; low-level enemies that cannot pass the gate, cannon fodder for the Rotor.
outcome: base-plan finds the forward lane cell past the mouth, the rock cell beside it (the Rotor's socket, no slab) and a fodder cell six lane cells out. The beats grant and order the Rotor there, hand control over 1.5 s after it stands, and spawn phage from the fodder cell at 2.5 s intervals with caps of eight alive and twenty total, only when a gate exists. td-tab: the pilot boot block became enterPilot(posts) so the story can enter sentry control at runtime on the printed Rotor; a take-control shot (platform takeControlPose) orbits three quarters round the tower and settles behind it; enemies treat the closed gate's cell as a wall through story.sealed; the opening garrison and the next-wave card are skipped in story mode; the acceptance state exposes beats, tower cells and enemies inside the clearing. sentry-pilot hides the practice chrome and ignores weapon digits when story. The lane end is the story's spawn cell so the optic faces down the lane. Controller size unchanged. Found along the way: the game's start-of-run garrison was ordering two Rotors ahead of Isao's, which is why the beat stayed in printing.
alternatives: Reload into ?sentryPilot=1 after the print: rejected, that mode commits six practice Needles at its own posts.
Block the gate cell in the map for everyone: rejected earlier; the reachability seal would swallow the outside world.
evidence: test/base-plan.mjs (wall socket, fodder cell), test/story-beats.mjs (control once, capped fodder) pass; npm test 89
node scripts/browser-test.mjs --story-world: PASS control, gate, fodder with insideEnemies 0 at stage 4
